In preparing those accounts, the Board of Directors is required to:"}, {"bbox": [104, 294, 483, 310], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Select suitable accounting policies and then apply them consistently;"}, {"bbox": [104, 309, 456, 324], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Make judgments and estimates that are reasonable and prudent;"}, {"bbox": [104, 324, 671, 354], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Prepare the consolidated financial statements on the basis of compliance with accounting standards and system and other related regulations;"}, {"bbox": [104, 353, 671, 383], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Prepare the consolidated financial statements on going concern basis unless it is inappropriate to presume that the Group will continue in business."}, {"bbox": [104, 390, 671, 451], "category": "Text", "text": "The Board of Directors is responsible for ensuring that proper accounting records are kept which disclosed, with reasonable accuracy at any time, the financial position of Group and to ensure that the accounting records comply with the registered accounting system. It is responsible for safeguarding the assets of the Group and hence for taking reasonable steps for the prevention and detection of fraud and other irregularities."}, {"bbox": [104, 456, 671, 516], "category": "Text", "text": "We, the Board of Directors, confirm that the consolidated financial statements for the year ended as at December 31st, 2025 prepared by us, give a true and fair view of the financial position as at December 31st, 2025, its financial performance and cash flows in the year 2025 of Group in accordance with Vietnamese Accounting Standards and comply with relevant statutory requirements."}, {"bbox": [104, 531, 365, 546], "category": "Section-header", "text": "Approval of Consolidated Financial Statement"}, {"bbox": [104, 552, 398, 612], "category": "Text", "text": "We, The Board of Management of Development Investment Construction Joint Stock Company approved our Consolidated Financial Statements for the year 2025 as set out on page 05 to page 55"}, {"bbox": [104, 641, 322, 657], "category": "Text", "text": "On behalf of the Board of Management"}, {"bbox": [322, 623, 369, 668], "category": "Picture"}, {"bbox": [452, 641, 648, 657], "category": "Text", "text": "On behalf of the Board of Directors"}, {"bbox": [471, 667, 724, 744], "category": "Picture"}, {"bbox": [101, 772, 221, 804], "category": "Caption", "text": "Nguyen Hung Cuong\nChairman"}, {"bbox": [101, 811, 191, 827], "category": "Text", "text": "March 25th, 2026"}, {"bbox": [452, 772, 557, 804], "category": "Caption", "text": "Nguyen Quang Tin\nGeneral Director"}, {"bbox": [548, 768, 629, 813], "category": "Picture"}, {"bbox": [381, 976, 388, 989], "category": "Page-footer", "text": "3"}]
